record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: If A is a non-unital Banach lattice algebra, can it be embedded in a unital Banach lattice superalgebra B in such a way that every lattice algebra homomorphism from A into a unital Banach lattice algebra C extends uniquely to a unital lattice and algebra homomorphism from B into C ? If we restrict C to lie in the class of unital Banach lattice algebras with positive identities, can we make B have a positive identity?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Banach lattice algebra is a Banach lattice $A$ that is also an associative algebra such that the product of two positive elements is positive and $\|xy\|\le\|x\|\,\|y\|$ for all $x,y\in A$. A lattice algebra homomorphism between Banach lattice algebras is a linear map that is simultaneously an algebra homomorphism and a lattice homomorphism (i.e., preserves the lattice operations $\vee,\wedge$). A unital Banach lattice algebra is one possessing a multiplicative identity $\mathbf{1}$; if $\mathbf{1}\ge 0$ one says the identity is positive.

(a) Let $A$ be a non-unital Banach lattice algebra. Does there exist a unital Banach lattice algebra $B$ together with an isometric lattice algebra embedding $\iota\colon A\hookrightarrow B$ with the following universal property: for every unital Banach lattice algebra $C$ and every lattice algebra homomorphism $\varphi\colon A\to C$, there exists a unique unital lattice algebra homomorphism $\widetilde\varphi\colon B\to C$ (i.e. an algebra homomorphism that is also a lattice homomorphism and sends the identity of $B$ to the identity of $C$) such that $\widetilde\varphi\circ\iota=\varphi$?

(b) If, in (a), one restricts $C$ to vary only over unital Banach lattice algebras whose identity is positive, can $B$ be chosen so that its identity is also positive?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of constructing a universal unitalization of a Banach lattice algebra in the categorical sense is recognized in the literature as an open problem; surveys of open problems on Banach lattice algebras explicitly list this as unresolved, noting that the standard linear-span unitalization for Banach algebras has no known analogue in the lattice setting. No resolution was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattice algebras: some questions, but very few answers
status_evidence.snippet: A central open question asks whether there is a canonical way of adding an identity to a Banach lattice algebra A such that every algebra and lattice homomorphism into a unital Banach lattice algebra extends uniquely to a unital lattice and algebra homomorphism.
status_evidence.claim: The universal unitalization question for Banach lattice algebras is recorded as an open problem.
